summary: Iteration 11 — Passwordless SMS sign-in (Twilio Verify) fully verified. Backend: 16/16 pytests in /app/backend/tests/test_sms_auth.py PASS — pydantic 422 for empty/short phone, regex 400 'Enter a valid phone number' for bad input, Twilio 21608 → 400 with 'verified/upgrade' mapping for trial-account magic numbers, Twilio 20404 → 400 with 'No code request was found' friendly message, E.164 normalization confirmed for '4155552671', '(415) 555-2671', '+44 20 1234 5678' (none returned the 'enter a valid phone number' 400), no 5xx anywhere. Regression: /api/auth/login email+password still issues a JWT for customer@lumo.test; /api/real-estate, /api/autos, /api/inquiries still 200. Frontend (Playwright): /signin renders the mobile-first page with data-testid='signin-page' + 'signin-phone-input' + 'signin-send-code' + 'signin-pw-link'; typing '4155552671' and clicking 'Text me a code' POSTs to /api/auth/sms/start with body {"phone":"+14155552671"} (E.164 normalized client-side); when start is mocked 200, UI transitions to signin-code-form, signin-code-input is focused, resend shows 'Resend in 29s' counting down. With both /api/auth/sms/start and /api/auth/sms/verify mocked, entering code '123456' + Sign in navigates the SPA to /customer (smart redirect for role=customer). When /signin?next=%2Fjobs%2Fabc%2Fapply is used, the mocked successful sign-in lands on /jobs/abc/apply. /jobs/apply/electrician/Brooklyn redirects to /signin?next=%2Fregister%3Frole%3Dprovider%26job_category%3Delectrician%26city%3DBrooklyn (URL-encoded). Visiting /customer while logged out → redirects to /signin (no longer /login). Login page exposes 'Sign up with your phone' → /signin. NavBar 'Sign in' (data-testid='nav-login') and 'Get started' (data-testid='nav-register') both navigate to /signin on click — they are <button> elements (not anchors with href), so navigation is via onClick navigate(); the spec wording 'both href=/signin' is a minor wording mismatch but behaviour is identical. Landing hero CTA 'Create an account' anchor href='/signin' confirmed. Regression: document.getElementById('emergent-badge') === null on both /signin and /.

action_items: Minor spec wording: nav-login and nav-register are <button> elements (not <a href='/signin'>) — they call navigate('/signin') on click. Behaviour matches intent but the testid attribute on a <button> means you cannot assert `.href`. If the spec strictly requires an <a> with href='/signin' for SEO/crawlability, swap to <Link>/<a>. Otherwise no action needed.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_sms.py is well-isolated (~180 LOC, dependency-injected via create_router(db, create_access_token, now_iso)) — testable in isolation, no implicit globals.
Synchronous Twilio SDK is wrapped in asyncio.to_thread() — does NOT block the FastAPI event loop. Good.
Twilio error-code mapping (60200/60203/21608/20404) returns user-friendly 4xx with `raise HTTPException(...)` — never leaks SDK tracebacks. Verified no 5xx in any tested error path.

Phone normalization is best-effort and US-defaulted (10 digits → +1...). Edge case: a UK number entered without '+' (e.g. '442012345678' 12 digits) would get prefixed to '+442012345678' which is still valid; a stray '1' prefix would silently get +1-prefixed — acceptable for v1.
MongoDB '_id' is correctly stripped from the response payload via comprehension `{k: v for k, v in user_doc.items() if k != '_id' and k != 'password_hash'}`. Good.
Synthetic email scheme `sms+{digits}@lumo.passwordless` guarantees uniqueness for the existing /auth/me lookup path. Good.

DEV fallback (when TWILIO_* env vars are missing) hard-codes OTP=123456 — fine for offline tests but logs a WARNING (good); make sure prod never ships without the keys (the test environment does have them set).
Frontend SignIn.jsx normalize() mirrors backend logic; smartReturn() correctly preserves ?next= across the two-step flow.
Protected → Navigate('/signin') change in App.js is consistent across all 12 protected routes.
test_credentials: Used seeded customer@lumo.test / password123 for the password-login regression. SMS test numbers: +15005550001 (Twilio magic invalid number) and +15005550006 (Twilio magic valid-but-unverified) — both returned 400 with mapped messages, no real SMS sent, no trial credits consumed.
seed_data_creation: None. No SMS-created users were persisted because no successful verify call ran against real Twilio (all happy-path tests were frontend-mocked via page.route()).
context_for_next_testing_agent: SMS auth mounted at /api/auth/sms/{start,verify}. Twilio account is in TRIAL — never call /api/auth/sms/start with real numbers; use +1 500 555 0001-0010 magic numbers for backend contract tests (they return 400 21608 mapping, no credit spend). Frontend happy-path requires page.route() mocking of both /api/auth/sms/start and /api/auth/sms/verify; also mock /api/auth/me when you want the post-verify navigation to stick (otherwise the real /api/auth/me returns 401 with the fake JWT and AuthProvider may show a runtime overlay in dev mode — purely cosmetic, doesn't block navigation). nav-login and nav-register are <button> tags (testids present, but no href attr); assert navigation by clicking and checking page.url. Smart redirect priority: ?next=... wins over role-based default.
